name: Monotonic co-VC Dimension / Star Number
details: Every realized star becomes a hollow star after its centre is removed.
proof: Let $h_0,h_1,\ldots,h_d$ witness a $d$-star in a projection of $\mathcal H$.  In the subfamily formed by $h_1,\ldots,h_d$, the centre trace of $h_0$ is absent while each of its $d$ one-coordinate flips is present. Thus that subfamily has co-VC dimension at least $d$, and maximizing over subfamilies proves $\mathrm{coVC}^*(\mathcal H)\ge\mathrm S(\mathcal H)$.
